elements_selected.content: Implement ffmpeg scene detection subprocess in ar-edit-core/src/index.rs per ADR-003. Command: ffmpeg -i <source> -vf "select='gt(scene,0.3)'" -vsync vfr ... Parse output to extract scene change timestamps. Create Scene structs with sequential indices and start_ms/end_ms.
